lessons.text: Day 1: 9z beat Aurora 2-0. That justified reviewing the market and map matchup; it did not prove that Aurora's July rebuild was an unpriced weakness in October.

Day 2: Aurora beat NIP 2-0; Falcons beat 9z 2-1; BETBOOM beat PARIVISION 2-1; FURIA beat Legacy 2-1. A competitive series is context, not a numeric probability adjustment. The archived headline and leaderboard strategies each went 2/3 on the three retained pre-lock picks: too small a sample to establish an edge.
Day 3: Aurora beat 9z 2-0, including a different Aurora map pick and a Nuke ban. The lesson is to reprice the next opponent and veto, not overreact to either sweep.

Aurora's kyxsan, Jimpphat and ash rebuild was reported on 8 July. It is about three months old, not last-minute onboarding. No new injury, stand-in, travel or sleep claim has been independently established here.
